pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided dark regions characterized by moderately sharp edge gradients and high spatial density relative to the intervening light pelage.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial space with varying pixel thickness and multiple tri-radiate junction nodes across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated 1D silhouette against the background along the upper neck and shoulder.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible vertical linear indentations and textural striations on the anterior flank and shoulder region.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark, avian-shaped silhouette attached to the mid-posterior flank area.
